observation_policy: No PASS without actual corresponding target/device observation; static/analyzer/synthetic control checks do not substitute.

cases.action: Verify guest isolation and hashes before launching

criteria.requirement: Guest OS/build/account class; no personal stores/mappings; exact installer SHA256; network-disabled state

cases.action: Snapshot guest, run installer offline into guest-only location

criteria.requirement: Installation receipt/exit, guest-only file inventory/hashes, uninstall/shortcut/config changes; compare770 payload identities; do not execute uninstaller implicitly

cases.action: Launch archived launcher offline

criteria.requirement: Actual wrapper→bootstrap→launcher process tree and JVM command identities; no successful network calls; missing-cache errors/cancellation visible

cases.action: Start from empty guest game cache; approve narrowly scoped public network downloads

criteria.requirement: Recorded catalog→version JSON→client/library/native/asset/runtime requests, status/size/hash and destination; no Microsoft sign-in

cases.action: Compare warm-cache versus empty-cache preparation

criteria.requirement: Existing valid content reused, missing/corrupt synthetic copies re-fetched; complete receipts; only guest test files may be altered

cases.action: Interrupt transfer and resume using guest snapshot/test copies

criteria.requirement: Bounded retries, partial-range behavior, final hash checking, no success for truncated output

cases.action: Simulate full/readonly guest test volume and cancellation

criteria.requirement: Explicit error and recoverable state; no false install completion; preserve snapshot for comparison

cases.action: Exercise configuration/profile migration with synthetic empty accounts only

criteria.requirement: Settings precedence, temporary-file and replace behavior, malformed JSON/error backup, restart persistence; no real token values

cases.action: Hash-pinned E20 signed metadata plus corrupted/truncated copies; run only in approved guest

criteria.requirement: Check matching embedded-key fixture origin/hash; actual signed-path acceptance and corrupted/truncated rejection receipts; never substitute an analyst key or change the target trust anchor

cases.action: Test each loader path identified from exact metadata

criteria.requirement: Parent/duplicate resolution, native/classpath/options and processor behavior; pin every artifact; no blanket Forge/Fabric parity result

cases.action: Game process/exit/error controls after explicit game-execution approval

criteria.requirement: Correct JVM major, args/native identities, exit handling and UI restore; game/account requirements respected

cases.action: Owner-controlled account tests, separately authorized

criteria.requirement: Microsoft/XBL/XSTS/Minecraft/ownership/profile outcomes only; no account names, tokens, device codes or raw auth traffic retained

cases.action: Owner installs approved exact package; record identity/build/dependencies

criteria.requirement: Package activates on Series X; actual executable/runtime hashes match receipt

cases.action: Run outside debugger and measure memory/CPU/GPU during launcher idle/load

criteria.requirement: Actual package resource budget recorded; no inference from historical generic limits or expandedResources declaration

cases.action: Synthetic JVM invocation for each current/java21/java17/legacy package

criteria.requirement: LoadPackagedLibrary/JNI API result, requested/accepted JNI version, Java major and exception result captured; no game/account required

cases.action: Synthetic filesystem/thread/ZIPFS tests using app-local data

criteria.requirement: Read/write/rename/ZIP behavior within allowed roots; no broad-file capability assumption

cases.action: JNI/native load probe against exact packaged/selected modules

criteria.requirement: Every required module/dependency/symbol resolves through actual package policy; full errors retained without credentials

cases.action: Graphics probe: context version/profile/extensions, shader compile/link, draw/present

criteria.requirement: Required backend/capabilities verified; compare actual GL extensions with glfwExtensionSupported behavior; no success from an empty window alone

cases.action: Controller, keyboard, pointer/focus/disconnect/reconnect

criteria.requirement: Button/axis/mouse/UI behavior matches explicit expectations; test mapping/hats/Win32-HWND-dependent consumers separately

cases.action: Audio probe including device loss

criteria.requirement: Playback/capture policy, device switching, latency/failure result measured; historical desktop OpenAL log is insufficient

cases.action: Suspend/resume and terminate/relaunch

criteria.requirement: No stuck keys, invalid context/audio, save loss or unsafe second-JVM reuse; record lifecycle markers and frame/resource changes

cases.action: Download/repair of approved target with existing account gate respected

criteria.requirement: Exact manifest/counters/hashes; no bypass to make Local Launcher Mode repair/play succeed

cases.action: Owner-authorized legitimate owned target launch

criteria.requirement: Existing entitlement/profile checks pass legitimately; exact version/loader/runtime/native/graphics tuple recorded; gameplay observable

cases.action: Repeat per catalog row and regression profile

criteria.requirement: Each of 56 rows independently PASSED/FAILED/BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE; unsupported legacy provider remains explicit

cases.action: Phase 5F.2 UI regression

criteria.requirement: Installed/Installed-Off persistence, no duplicate install, correct active profile, failed download and account gates retained

Every current behavioral case and target remains BLOCKED
All 56 approved targets are retained; unsupported legacy providers are not silently counted as tested
Nested field names are restricted; free text and attachment bytes still require manual privacy review
X12 receipt validation binds exact tuples and predecessor receipts; aggregate 56-target and four-runtime-family completeness requires a separate coverage review
Synthetic checker controls and compilation of independently written probes are analyst checks, never behavioral target passes
